$comment: POST /v2/spaces -- verified against the Meet API v2 Discovery Document 2026-09-16. Every field is optional; an empty body creates a space with Google's defaults. The response's meetingUri is the join link the meeting bot's runtime (out of scope for this connector) actually joins.
title: Create meeting space
description: Create a new Google Meet space and get its join link.
$idempotencyComment: spaces.create has no documented idempotency key. A retry creates a SECOND space with its own meeting code and link, never returns the first.

config.label: Who can join
config.description: OPEN: anyone with the link, no knock. TRUSTED: anyone in your organization, no knock; others knock. RESTRICTED: only people and groups explicitly invited. Leave blank for Google's account default.

options.label: Restricted — invited people and groups only

config.label: Entry points
config.description: ALL: any Meet client (web, mobile, phone dial-in, the calling API). CREATOR_APP_ONLY: only the app that created the space, and only through the Meet REST API and SIP — no phone dial-in and no other Meet client. Leave blank for Google's default (ALL).

outputShape.description: The short, human-typeable code shown in the Meet UI (part of meetingUri).
Echoes what was requested, or Google's default when omitted.
Echoes what was requested, or Google's default (ALL) when omitted.
